desc: Prove the scheduling formula for one query: \(\max(M,\lceil S/2\rceil)\), where \(S\) is total required divisions and \(M=\text{steps}(r)\).
Derive a prefix function \(F(n)=\sum_{x=1}^{n}\text{steps}(x)\) using base-4 power blocks.
Implement \(S=F(r)-F(l-1)\) in \(O(\log_4 10^9)\) per query with integer arithmetic.
Verify the supplied code on both provided examples and exact power-of-four boundary intervals.
Produce code in `Solution.minOperations`, summing \(\max(\text{steps}(r), (S+1)//2)\) across queries.
